block_instructions: Never merge a pull request. Block gh pr merge, including --squash and --admin, gh api and curl calls that merge a pull request, and the mergePullRequest GraphQL mutation. A person squash-merges.
Never approve a pull request. Block gh pr review --approve and -a, and a reviews API call whose event is APPROVE.
Never push to main or master, including a refspec such as HEAD:main and a force push aimed at those branches.
